name: Mars Observer
about: Mars Observer (1992-063A, JPL), launched 1992 Sep 25. Its phases from GCAT: HCO, Mars. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Mars on GCAT's date); its perihelion 1.001 au and aphelion 1.632 au against GCAT's 1.003 and 1.633
